subject: [PATCH 34/60] mm/mempolicy: don't rebind policies onto private nodes

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: The patch introduces a new function to handle rebinding policies over cpuset's nodes other than private ones. It also updates existing functions to use this new function, ensuring that adding or removing a private node does not move any policy.

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch series addresses rebinding policies onto private nodes in the mm/mempolicy code. It introduces a new function, mpol_rebindable_mems(), to handle rebinding policies over cpuset's nodes other than private ones. The patch also updates existing functions to use this new function and ensures that adding or removing a private node does not move any policy.
